FAZAL & SONS / YOUR INFORMATION

Privacy Policy.

Last updated: 29 October 2026

This policy explains how information is handled when you visit our website or contact Fazal and Sons Construction Development about your project.

Information you choose to share

When you contact us by phone or WhatsApp, you may share your name, contact number, project location, and details about your construction plans. Please share only information relevant to your enquiry.

The website’s project enquiry tool prepares a message in your browser. Preparing or copying the brief does not submit it to us. If you choose to continue on WhatsApp, the brief is included in a WhatsApp link; you decide whether to send the message there.

How your enquiry is used

Information you send us is used to respond to your questions, discuss your requirements, prepare estimates, and communicate about requested services. For questions about information held in our business correspondence, contact us using the details below.

Website hosting and technical information

The website is hosted on Vercel. Delivering and protecting the website may involve processing technical information such as your IP address, browser information, requested pages, and request times. Hosting providers handle this information under their own policies.

Google tags and cookies

The home page includes a Google tag integration for advertising measurement. When configured and active, it may send technical information and interaction events, such as clicks on phone or WhatsApp links and preparation of a project brief, to Google. The event tracking code does not include the name, location, or message entered in the enquiry form.

Google services may use cookies or similar technologies depending on their configuration and your browser settings. You can manage cookies through your browser and advertising preferences through Google’s controls. See Google’s Privacy Policy for details.

Links to other services

Phone buttons open your device’s calling application. WhatsApp and Google Maps links take you to external services, which process information under their own privacy policies. Opening WhatsApp with a prepared enquiry shares the brief with that service as part of the link.

Read the WhatsApp Privacy Policy and Vercel Privacy Policy for their practices.

Questions and requests

To ask about your enquiry information, request a correction, or discuss removal of information you have shared with us, call or message our team. We will discuss your request and any records needed for ongoing work.
